ranking.note: Raised to P1: a ThreadSanitizer-confirmed data race in the interface external miners actually use is a reliability/correctness defect, above the feature-level P2s on this list.
Kept P2 but placed first among them: removes per-tick full template assembly and cs_main contention, and introduces the BlockTemplateManager that #33922/#36356/#36357 build on.
Moved up from 14: overflow producing negative chunk fees makes getblocktemplate silently drop prioritised transactions, which is template-content correctness, the top concern in this category.
Placed ahead of #36357 because that PR is based on it; the lifetime/global-state fix is the prerequisite.
Moved down from 7: developer tooling and test harness ranks below template-correctness and interface fixes per this category's ordering.
Moved down from 9: regtest-only convenience for simulating pool payouts, no effect on production template construction.
Lowered to P4: reviewers confirm the no-mempool lookup path is unreachable in production, so this is a narrow contract-consistency tidy-up.

inconsistencies: Chain: #36357 is explicitly based on #36356; review #36356 first or the stats move will not apply cleanly.
Chain: #36870 states it depends on #36862 to avoid tripping interface_ipc_mining; #36862 must land first.

#35581 introduces BlockTemplateManager, while #33922 (getMemoryLoad), #36356 (gbt cache) and #36357 (assembler statics) all add state to that same class; settle #35581's shape before the three dependents to avoid rework.

Capnp interface churn overlaps across #35300 (precious arg, deprecates ordinals), #36097 (replaces interrupt methods with cancellation args), #35671 (TxCollection), #33922 (getMemoryLoad) and #36525 (getTotalFees); ordinal assignment and client-compat errors need to be coordinated, and #36097's RFC-agreed cancellation design should probably be decided before #35300 adds another blocking-call variant.

#36525 adds a mutex around m_block_template while #33922 tracks live templates via weak references; both touch template lifetime in BlockTemplateImpl and should be reviewed together, #36525 first as the bug fix.
result.notes: Only one P1: the confirmed race in the mining IPC. The P2 block is all interface-completeness/latency work for external (Stratum v2) consumers; it is genuinely distinct from the P3 band of localized bug fixes, test-reliability fixes and tooling, so the spread is kept.
